elements.element: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products"

elements.element: Restriction limited to a named competing product
elements.evidence: narrowed to "with respect to Deerskin Products"; the sweep "or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled ...)" was deleted

elements.element: Restriction operative during the term only
elements.evidence: "during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate" (retained; no survival tail)
"and in any event for no longer than 12 months"
"shall not apply to the Company's internal development of web sites or e-commerce capabilities"
"or to any business or web site acquired by the Company"

reasons: Locked fallback level is fully satisfied: the restriction is confined to the defined Deerskin Products, runs during the term with an express 12-month outer cap, and both required carve-outs (internal development and acquired businesses/web sites) are inserted.
Preferred position is not met because a field-of-use restriction on the Company survives, but that is expected at the locked fallback level.

Minimal: the edit deletes only the over-broad 'substantially similar products / named competitors' sweep, inserts a short duration cap, and adds one concise carve-out sentence rather than rewriting the clause.

Intent preserved: HDI's exclusive 'Deerskin' brand right for a self-contained site and Section 6.2's closeout-merchandise reservation remain effective; no undefined term or dangling cross-reference is introduced (the new sentence correctly cites Section 6.1).
